title: SCAP-NG declared CPE identity v0.4.1
description: A lossless source CPE identity declared by a Benchmark platform. This metadata is not an applicability decision or a CPE matching result.

value.description: Exact source CPE spelling, including escaping and packed-edition syntax; no normalization or matching is implied.

binding.description: CPE naming binding used by the source value.

kind.description: Source provenance kind; it does not authorize executable matching.

id.description: Source CPE/platform identity associated with this declaration.

idref.description: Original source identifier or reference, when present.

href.description: Original source component location, when present.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source identity element or preserved source provenance record.

source.description: Immutable source provenance for the declared identity.
